Irene,

Apologies for the delayed payment — we ran into a banking remittance lag tied to our UK treasury migration. Our finance team has asked if Redwood can accept a staged settlement: 40% this month, 30% on Feb 15, and the remaining 30% on Mar 15.

Separately, we need confirmation of the VAT treatment — our tax team thinks this should be VAT-exempt under cross-border services but we need the invoice to show the UK VAT ID and supporting evidence (SOW + place-of-supply note). Can you confirm before we schedule the first wire?

Thanks — Liam

1) We sign off on the staged schedule you proposed (40% now / 30% 2028-02-15 / 30% 2028-03-15).
2) Orion provides the UK VAT ID and confirmation of cross-border place-of-supply (a single sentence from your tax team is fine).
3) Redwood issues a corrected invoice page showing the VAT ID and a billing note about place-of-supply.
4) We will waive the standard late fee for this invoice only if the first tranche is received by 2028-01-20.

I've attached the signed SOW and the original invoice for reference. Kim and Markus — looping you in for approval on the waiver and staged terms (we typically require 60% at first touch; this is a concession).
